description:
Harken back to the 1890's with this beautiful Bone Shaker with 52" super sized wheel. Great for Display or unique riding experience

Same as BS38, but with 52" wheel. For riders with inseam of 35" or taller. Overall dimensions 66"x61"x32". Recommended for taller riders only. Ships via truck. Size Recommendation Inseam 35" or greater Inseam measurements are crotch to ankle (pant leg size). These are recommended "rules of thumb" only, and not written in stone. size selection guide 38" requires an inseam Between28" and 32" 48" requires an inseam between 29" and 35" 52" requires an inseam 35" or more the color is BLACK...Inseam measurements are crotch to ankle (pant leg size). These are recommended "rules of thumb" only, and not written in stone. Ships via truck. Freight cost range within 48 mainland states states $359-$459 and lead time generally 2-5 weeks.
